name: market-analytics-dashboard
description: React market analytics dashboard with demo market data, risk monitoring, relative-strength analysis, and options analytics.

paragraphs: A browser-based equity market analytics dashboard. It classifies the market environment, ranks symbols by relative strength, resamples price history across timeframes, scores technical setups against a transparent factor model, sizes positions from a risk budget, and prices options with Black-Scholes.
It runs entirely on synthetic data generated in the browser. Clone it, install, and it works — no API keys, no accounts, no configuration.

I kept writing the same analytics by hand — moving-average structure, ATR distance, relative strength, position size — and wanted them in one place with the reasoning visible rather than buried in a spreadsheet.
features: Market regime classification. Reads breadth across 11 sector ETFs, benchmark trend structure, realised volatility, and defensive-versus-cyclical leadership, then classifies the environment as Risk-On, Constructive,…

Multi-timeframe analysis. Daily bars are resampled into weekly and monthly buckets rather than fetched separately. Trend direction is compared across timeframes and flagged when they disagree.
